content.value_statement: Status and progress patterns can confuse users when the wrong indicator appears. This skill applies Apple HIG guidance to choose progress bars, spinners, status bars, and activity rings.
actual_capabilities: Recommends determinate or indeterminate progress indicators based on task duration and measurability.
Explains when to use progress bars, circular indicators, spinners, and refresh controls.
Provides status bar guidance for visibility, contrast, safe areas, and immersive media.
Summarizes Activity ring rules for Move, Exercise, Stand, HealthKit, colors, and platform support.
Covers accessibility considerations for progress updates and VoiceOver announcements.
Points to relevant Apple platform APIs such as ProgressView, UIProgressView, and HKActivityRingView.
limitations: Does not replace current Apple documentation for newly released platform changes.
Does not implement UI code or validate screenshots automatically.
Focuses on Apple platforms and may not fit Android or web design systems.
Requires product context to recommend exact placement, labels, and behavior.

use_cases.title: Choose Loading Feedback
use_cases.description: Select the right indicator for downloads, uploads, sync, refresh, and unknown-duration tasks.

use_cases.title: Review Apple App UI
use_cases.description: Check status bars, safe areas, progress labels, and accessibility behavior before release.

use_cases.title: Design Fitness Progress Views
use_cases.description: Use Activity rings only for Apple fitness goals and avoid misleading ring-like visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Pick an Indicator
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner guidance for a single loading state.
prompt_templates.prompt: I am designing an Apple app. The task is [task], it usually takes [duration], and progress is [known or unknown]. Recommend the right status or progress indicator.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of progress behavior across a user journey.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Apple app flow for HIG status and progress guidance: [flow details]. Identify indicator type, placement, labels, cancellation, and accessibility updates.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Platform Behavior
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced guidance for multi-platform Apple apps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare how this status or progress pattern should work on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS: [pattern]. Include relevant Apple APIs and platform limits.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Activity Rings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for fitness and health interfaces.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this fitness interface for Activity ring compliance: [interface description]. Check ring purpose, colors, HealthKit usage, labels, margins, notifications, and branding risks.

output_examples.input: Should a file upload show a spinner or progress bar?
output_examples.output: Use a determinate progress bar when upload progress is measurable. Place it near the upload item and include cancel behavior if interruption is safe.

output_examples.input: Can my habit app use Apple-style activity rings for streaks?
output_examples.output: Avoid Apple Activity rings for unrelated streak data. Use a clearly different visual treatment so users do not confuse it with Move, Exercise, or Stand progress.

output_examples.input: Should I hide the iPhone status bar during onboarding?
output_examples.output: Keep the status bar visible unless the experience is immersive media, gameplay, or AR. Preserve readable contrast and avoid interactive controls behind it.

best_practices: Use determinate progress when the app can report meaningful completion.
Place progress feedback where the related content or action occurs.
Keep Activity rings reserved for Move, Exercise, and Stand data.
anti_patterns: Using a spinner when a reliable percentage or remaining work estimate is available.
Hiding the status bar permanently in a standard app flow.
Reusing Activity ring colors or shapes for branding, decoration, or unrelated metrics.

faq.question: When should I use a progress bar instead of a spinner?
faq.answer: Use a progress bar when the app can measure completion. Use a spinner when duration or progress is unknown.

faq.question: Can I switch from a spinner to a progress bar?
faq.answer: Switch from indeterminate to determinate when progress becomes known, but avoid shape changes that disrupt the interface.

faq.question: Does this skill cover status bar safe areas?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers readability, contrast, safe areas, and when temporary hiding can be appropriate.

faq.question: Can Activity rings show any circular progress value?
faq.answer: No. Apple Activity rings should represent Move, Exercise, and Stand information only.

faq.question: Does this skill generate SwiftUI code?
faq.answer: No. It recommends HIG-aligned behavior and APIs, but it does not produce complete implementation code.
